title.value: When Do Transformers Shine in RL? Decoupling Memory from Credit Assignment
title.justification: The title of the paper is directly provided at the beginning of the document.
title.quote: When Do Transformers Shine in RL? Decoupling Memory from Credit Assignment

extractions.description: This paper investigates the role of Transformers in reinforcement learning (RL) by distinguishing between their memory and credit assignment capabilities. The study introduces formal definitions of memory length and credit assignment length, and designs tasks to measure these aspects. The results indicate that Transformers enhance memory in RL tasks but do not improve long-term credit assignment.

climate_change_is_central.justification: The paper primarily focuses on the performance of Transformers in reinforcement learning tasks by analyzing memory and credit assignment capabilities, rather than addressing any specific climate change challenges or applications.
climate_change_is_central.quote: The Transformer architecture has been very successful to solve problems that involve long-term dependencies, including in the RL domain... Our empirical results reveal that Transformers can enhance the memory capability of RL algorithms
